suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as phenotype specific arrhythmia induced cardiomyopathy. Require a sustained or sufficiently burdensome culprit arrhythmia/tachyarrhythmia plus separately documented ventricular dysfunction consistent with arrhythmia-induced cardiomyopathy. Do not generalize to all transient or incidental arrhythmias. Reversibility after rhythm/rate control, when documented, strengthens attribution. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Cardiac Arrhythmias (Atrial Fibrillation, Tachycardia) matches the source-specific phenotype
Independent diagnosis of Cardiomyopathy with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors

Resolution of the publication guard: Require a sustained or sufficiently burdensome culprit arrhythmia/tachyarrhythmia plus separately documented ventricular dysfunction consistent with arrhythmia-induced cardiomyopathy. Do not generalize to all transient or incidental arrhythmias. Reversibility after rhythm/rate control, when documented, strengthens attribution.
